visualGrammarGates.pageHeading: Exactly one visible h1. Its computed size must be greater than the product summary.
visualGrammarGates.panelHierarchy: Each visible panel title must be larger than its subtitle.
visualGrammarGates.headerMetrics: A visible page-header metric strip must match the product task-decision purpose.
visualGrammarGates.structuralSurfaces: Structural panes and primary work surfaces must stay flat. Only inset objects and overlays can use contained or raised treatment.
visualGrammarGates.neutralSurfaces: Primary content cannot be an all-card wall and can use at most two opaque neutral structural backgrounds.
visualGrammarGates.deterministicLayout: Direct primary-workspace regions must be stable and non-overlapping at every matrix width.
visualGrammarGates.widePlacement: At 1440px, region boxes must follow their declared wide rows, columns, and spans.
visualGrammarGates.controlOcclusion: Visible fixed and sticky controls cannot cover another task region.
visualGrammarGates.actionIcons: Distinct visible actions in one group cannot reuse one semantic icon.
visualGrammarGates.iconMetadata: Every icon in every visible button must expose data-icon-name. Button metadata must match the rendered icon.
